proof: Actual eight-player graph: a pending quarterfinal objection holds its own semifinal/final; unaffected quarters are actually played and their semifinal is populated. Another live game keeps scoring after independent approval.

Selected actual finish, category, voluntary private text and opponent response; no immediate unheard approval; one linked appeal to a different independent reviewer. Actual rescoring and both new signatures preserve original journal versions and close both dossiers.

Role revocation denies private GET and old receipt replay; server-clock request/response/appeal boundaries; actual expired evidence deletion plus metadata audit; no automatic penalty from conduct/camera category; runtime cannot rewrite case rows.

limits: This is actual local service/DB evidence, not a full physical browser/native/Oche evening.
Existing generic correction request excludes season-managed encounters; their canonical season decision and captain/ranking replay procedure remains authoritative.
Voluntary proof text is erased on expiry. Minimal official reasons, score provenance and decision journals remain preserved.
No automatic fraud finding or additional suspension/disqualification policy is introduced.
